records.title: Waterways In Karnataka
details: (a) & (b): Tender for carrying out Environmental Impact Assessment & Environmental Management plan has been floated for taking up development of floating jetties and navigational aids.

records.title: KONKAN RAILWAY UTTARA KANNADA REGION
details:
a to c: Telaguppa - Sirsi - Hubbali New Line: Final Location Survey (FLS) for Talaguppa - Sirsi _ Hubbali New Line (158 Km) via Tadas has been sanctioned for preparation of Detailed Project Report (DPR)
Accordingly preparation of Detailed Project Report (DPR) for double line has been taken up in consultation with all stakeholders.
